drawer_divider_set: Six compartments for the drawer where everything ends up.
stackable_storage_bin: A deep bin with a rim for the next one to sit on. Nobody stops at one.
gridfinity_baseplate_4x4: A sixteen-socket grid that bins click into. The start of a tidy obsession.
gridfinity_bin_pack_x6: Six little bins to fill the grid. There are never quite enough.
label_holder_clips_x10: Ten clips that hold a label on a shelf edge, so the shelf finally makes sense.
cable_tidy_box: A long lidded box that hides the extension lead and everything plugged into it.
hook_rail_x5_hooks: A rail with five hooks. Keys, leads and bags, all off the floor.
mail_sorter: Three slots for the post, the bills and the things to deal with later.
battery_organiser: Two stepped rows of cells, so the flat batteries stop mixing with the good ones.
remote_control_holder: Three slots and a tall back. The remote lives here now, in theory.
bag_clip_set_x6: Six clips for the open bags in the cupboard. Cheap and useful.
spice_jar_lid_adapters_x6: Six screw-on lids that turn odd jars into a matching set.
sock_and_underwear_drawer_grid: A twelve-pocket grid for the sock drawer. A big print for a small victory.
sticky_note_holder: A tray for the pad, a back to lean it on and a rest for the pen.
charging_cable_spool: Wind the spare cable round it and it stops knotting itself in the bag.
coat_peg_x3: Three sturdy pegs with a knob on the end. Screws not included.
lid_organiser_rack: Four upright panels that stand pan lids on edge and stop the avalanche.
pen_pot_hex: A six-sided pot for pens. Simple, tidy and on every desk eventually.
headphone_stand: A weighted base, a tall post and a curved rest for the headband.
phone_stand: Props a phone up at a sensible angle. A steady seller.
tablet_stand: A steep easel with a lip, for recipes, video calls and propping up a film.
business_card_holder: A small sloping holder for a stack of cards on the counter.
cable_management_clips_x12: Small, quick and boring. Sells forever.
webcam_cover_slider_x3: Three thin sliding covers. Tiny, quick and reassuring.
paper_tray_stackable: A letter tray with corner posts, so the next one stacks on top.
keyboard_wrist_rest_frame: A long, low frame that a gel pad drops into. Wrists will be grateful.
mouse_bungee: A weighted base and an arm that holds the mouse cable up out of the way.
planner_stand: A wide, laid-back easel that keeps an open planner in view.
stapler_dock: A cradle for the stapler with a corner for spare staples.
desk_lamp_shade: A faceted cone shade for a tired desk lamp. A long print that shows off the filament.
bulldog_clip_display_wall: An upright board with six pegs to hang clips on, where they can be found.
ruler_and_template_set: A ruler, a set square and a circle template, printed flat in one go.
cookie_cutter_set_x6: Six cutters in six shapes, from a triangle to a circle.
herb_stripper: Pull a stem through the right hole and the leaves come off. Oddly satisfying.
bag_sealing_clips_x8: Eight slide-on sticks that seal a bag properly. The cereal stays crisp.
spice_rack_insert: Three steps with a lip on each, so the jars at the back can be read.
tea_bag_caddy: A deep box with six pockets, one for each kind of tea.
coffee_scoop: A round measure on a long handle. One scoop, one cup.
coffee_pod_holder: Two tall towers on a base that pods stack inside.
recipe_card_stand: A small easel that keeps the recipe upright and out of the flour.
utensil_holder: A tall round pot for the spoons and spatulas beside the hob.
cake_topper_custom_text: A banner on two stakes with raised lettering. Made to order, one name at a time.
napkin_holder: Two upright panels on a narrow base. Does one job and does it well.
fruit_bowl_low_poly: A wide, faceted bowl that flares from a small foot. The centre of the table.
wine_bottle_holder: A long base with two cradles: one for the body, one for the neck.
pasta_measure: Four joined rings, one for each number of portions. Ends the guesswork.
cookie_stamp_set: Three round stamps with chunky handles for pressing patterns into dough.
drawer_bin_for_cutlery: Three lanes for knives, forks and spoons, and one across the back for the rest.
cotton_bud_dispenser: A tall hopper with a catch tray at the front. Refill from the top.
toothpaste_squeezer: Slide the tube through and turn the key. Gets the last of it out.
nail_polish_rack: Three steps between two cheeks, so every bottle can be seen.
hair_tie_holder: A post on a round base to loop hair ties over, so they stop vanishing.
hanging_planter: A flared pot on three arms that meet at a ring. Hang it by a window.
controller_wall_mount_x2: Two wall brackets with upturned prongs. Controllers off the sofa at last.
controller_stand: A round base, a leaning neck and a cradle with upturned ends.
vr_headset_stand: A tall stand with a head-shaped top, so the headset keeps its shape.
camera_lens_cap_holder: A shallow cup the cap presses into, with lugs to thread a strap through.
sd_card_holder: Six narrow slots for memory cards. Small, quick and easy to post.
usb_stick_organiser: A round puck with six sockets. Every stick upright and in sight.
keyboard_case_60: A long tray for a compact keyboard build, with posts inside and a cable port.
smartwatch_charging_stand: A leaning post with a round pad for the charger. Tidies the bedside table.
console_vertical_stand: A low base with two rails that hold a console on its edge.
cable_comb_set: Three flat combs that keep a bundle of cables running side by side.
miniature_display_shelf: Three steps in front of a back board. A painted army deserves a stage.
wargaming_terrain_ruined_building: The corner of a ruin, with broken walls and rubble. Good cover for small soldiers.
wargaming_terrain_crates_and_barrels_x10: Six crates and four barrels to scatter across the table.
wargaming_terrain_walls_and_barricades: A battlement wall, two barriers and a stack of logs. An instant front line.
wargaming_terrain_forest_bases: Three rough bases with tree stumps. Add foliage and call it a wood.
dungeon_tiles_x10: Ten floor tiles, some with a wall or a pillar. The dungeon grows a room at a time.
sci_fi_bulkheads_x6: Six braced wall panels, for corridors on a ship that has seen better days.
paint_pot_rack: Three stepped rows of pockets. Twelve pots, every colour in sight.
hobby_brush_holder: Two toothed bars on a base, so wet brushes lie flat and apart.
miniature_painting_handle: A chunky grip with a clamp on top. Holds the model so fingers don't.
card_shuffler_housing: The body of a crank shuffler: two sloping card plates and a handle on the front.
movement_tray: A shallow tray with eight sockets that moves a whole unit at once.
poker_chip_holder: Five channels of chips under a carry handle.
mahjong_tile_rack: A long rack with a ledge and a leaning back for a row of tiles.
retro_console_cartridge_holder: Six slots that stand old game cartridges on edge.
train_track_pieces_x10: Ten wooden-style track pieces with joining tabs. The layout is never finished.
dino_skeleton_kit: A dinosaur skeleton with spine, ribs, skull and tail, standing on its own four feet.
mask_half_face: An eye mask that curves round the face. Sand, prime, paint, convention.
plague_doctor_mask: A rounded head piece with a long drooping beak and goggle rims.
horns_pair: Two curved horns on round pads, ready to fix to a headband.
potion_bottle_stoppers_x6: Six tapered stoppers topped with faceted gems. The bottle is someone else's job.
low_poly_planter: Faceted pot for succulents. Looks more expensive than it is.
lithophane_photo_panel: A thin picture panel between two posts. Put a light behind it and the photo appears.
lithophane_lamp: A round lamp with a picture sleeve between the base and the cap. Glows from inside.
moon_lamp: A faceted globe on a small stand. Everyone's first lamp.
tea_light_lantern: A square lantern with corner posts and a pyramid roof, for battery tea lights.
air_plant_holder_x3: Three small faceted cups in different shapes. Air plants ask for very little.
bust_sculpture_classical: Head and shoulders on a plinth. Makes any shelf look better read.
low_poly_animal_figurine: A faceted fox standing side on, ears up and tail out.
wall_shelf_hexagon: A six-sided frame with a shelf across the middle. Several make a honeycomb wall.
plant_mister_holder: A wall plate with a ring that the mister bottle drops into.
curtain_tie_backs_pair: Two wall hooks, each with a curled arm and a knob. Sold as a pair, naturally.
light_switch_cover: A square plate that dresses up a plain switch.
hair_comb: A flat comb with eight long teeth. Light, quick and well priced.
jewellery_stand_tree: A little tree with six branches to hang necklaces and rings on.
earring_display_card_stand: A small easel that holds a card of earrings on a stall.
button_set_x10: Ten flat buttons. A few grams of filament and a surprisingly good price.
tyre_tread_depth_gauge: A flat gauge with a sliding probe. Lives in the glovebox until the test is due.
marking_gauge: A beam through a fence block, with a thumbscrew and a scribing pin.
hex_key_holder: A strip of seven slots, one for each key size.
glue_bottle_holder: A solid block with three sockets that hold bottles nozzle down, ready to pour.
filament_clip_set_x10: Ten tiny clips that stop the end of a spool unwinding. For people with printers.
nozzle_and_tool_caddy: Small pockets for nozzles in front, two tall ones for tools behind.
calibration_cube_pack_of_10: Ten test cubes. Mostly bought by people who could print their own.
benchy_pack_of_5: Five little tug boats. The test print everyone knows, sold as a set.
skull_anatomy_model: A skull with a large cranium, eye sockets and a jaw. For the classroom, or the desk.
braille_alphabet_tiles: Square tiles with letters in raised dots, for learning by touch.
bridge_building_kit: A truss bridge with a deck and zigzag sides. Shows where the load goes.
fossil_replica: A coiled ammonite standing proud of a stone slab.
pendulum_wave_kit: A frame with five pendulums of different lengths. Set them swinging and watch the wave.
table_number_stands_x10: Ten little stands with an upright card for the table number.
balloon_weights_x4: Four chunky weights with a knob to tie the ribbon to.
birthday_number_topper: A flat number on two stakes for the top of the cake. Any age you like.
custom_cookie_cutter_logo: A cutter with a grip flange and a logo outline inside. One customer, one design.
initial_letter_shelf_decor: A chunky free-standing letter for the shelf. Pick the initial.
guitar_pick_holder: A pick-shaped dish for picks. They still end up in the wash.
recorder: A recorder with a flared foot and six finger holes. Parents may not thank you.
ocarina: A squashed egg with a mouthpiece and finger holes. Sounds better than it looks.
sheet_music_stand_clip: A big sprung clip that holds the page down when the window is open.
vinyl_record_display_stand: Two brackets and a bar that lean a record sleeve back for show.
vinyl_wall_mount_x3: Three slim ledges that put album covers on the wall.
card_holder_for_games: A long rack with three rising rows, so a hand of cards stands without being held.
tablet_stylus_holder: A short tube on a clip plate that keeps the stylus with the tablet.
cabinet_hinge_cover_x4: Four small caps for the hinges whose covers went missing years ago.
toy_battery_cover: A cover plate with grip ribs, hinge tabs and a latch. The toy works again.
remote_battery_door: A long door with tabs and a latch, to replace the one lost down the sofa.
film_canister_holder: Four six-sided tubes in a block, one for each roll.
battery_case_camera: A small box with an overhanging lid and a latch, for spare camera batteries.
filter_case: A flat round case with a hinged lid for a lens filter.
rc_transmitter_stand: Two side cheeks with hooks and a bar across the back. Keeps the sticks off the bench.
platform_benches_x10: Ten tiny benches for a station platform.
diorama_base_hex: A shallow six-sided tray with a couple of rocks, ready for scenery.
model_railway_tunnel_portal: A stone portal with an arch of five blocks and a parapet across the top.
bridge_girder_set: Two long plate girders joined by cross beams, for the line over the river.
skull_candle_holder: A skull with a candle cup in the top. Use a battery candle.
bat_garland_x10: Ten flat bats to thread on a string and hang across the hall.
spider_web_wall_decor: A flat web of spokes and rings, with a spider sitting on it.
witch_hat: A wide brim, a band and a tall cone that kinks over at the tip.
tombstone_set_x3: Three gravestones on plinths: a round top, a cross and a tapered slab.
skeleton_hand_bowl: A shallow bowl held up by five bony fingers. For sweets by the door.
halloween_cookie_cutters_x5: Five cutters: pumpkin, ghost, bat, tombstone and witch's hat.
crow_figurine: A plump crow with a long beak, watching from the shelf.
zombie_hand_garden_stake: A hand clawing up out of a mound of earth. Stand it by the path.
monster_tooth_necklace: A curved fang with a cap and a loop for the cord.
guy_fawkes_mask: An oval mask with brows, a long nose, an upturned moustache and a pointed beard.
reindeer_figurine: A long-legged reindeer with branching antlers.
christmas_cookie_cutters_x6: Six cutters: star, tree, bell, stocking, bauble and snowflake.
candle_arch: A window arch with five candles along the top and a tree inside.
snow_globe_base: A round stepped plinth with a rim for the globe and a key at the back.
christmas_lithophane: A picture panel on a base bar, with a raised Christmas tree on the front.
heart_lithophane: A heart-shaped panel rising from a base bar. Light it from behind.
easter_cookie_cutters_x5: Five cutters: egg, rabbit, chick, carrot and flower.
photo_lithophane_frame: A picture panel in a chunky frame with a strut at the back. Add a photo and a light.
locker_shelf: A free-standing shelf that makes two levels out of one locker.
protractor_and_compass_set: A protractor, a set square and a pair of compasses, printed flat.
